name: issue-table
title: Issue Table
description: An inline-editable issue database with sortable priorities.
usage: <IssueTable defaultIssues={[{ id: "UI-7", title: "Search", status: "active", priority: "high", points: 3 }]} />
useCases: During backlog triage, a manager sorts issues by priority and corrects a title inline.
In a team meeting, a coordinator changes a task’s status in the table. The board receives the same updated array and shows the new status.
task: An inline-editable issue database with sortable priorities.
behavior: In controlled mode onIssuesChange receives the full TrackerIssue array. Pass the updated issues back to the table and related views.
